What’s new

Find out what is new in Event Endpoint Management version 11.0.x.

Release 11.0.5

Security and bug fixes

Event Endpoint Management release 11.0.5 contains a bug fix which allows credentials generated in IBM API Connect to be accepted by the Event Gateway.

Release 11.0.4

Support for other Kubernetes platforms

In addition to the existing support for the Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform, Event Endpoint Management version 11.0.4 introduces support for installing on other Kubernetes platforms that support the Red Hat Universal Base Images (UBI) containers.

Documentation: Highlighting differences between versions

Security and bug fixes

Event Endpoint Management release 11.0.4 contains security and bug fixes.

Known issues

Credentials generated in IBM API Connect are not accepted by the Event Gateway.

Release 11.0.3

Catalog search

Event Endpoint Management 11.0.3 adds a way to search the catalog where users can more easily discover and locate a specific topic, or range of topics.

Security and bug fixes

Event Endpoint Management release 11.0.3 contains security and bug fixes.

Known issues

Manager logs contain java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException messages.

Release 11.0.2

Subscription management

Event Endpoint Management 11.0.2 adds a subscriptions page where users can view the topics they have subscribed to, and delete their subscriptions if required.

Release 11.0.1

Event Endpoint Management release 11.0.1 contains stability and bug fixes.

Known issues

Release 11.0.0

Event Endpoint Management 11.0.0 simplifies how users can discover, socialize, and use events in your organization. This release also makes Event Endpoint Management a stand-alone capability, meaning it no longer requires an instance of IBM API Connect instance to be deployed.

Find out what is new in Event Endpoint Management version 11.0.0.

Simpler socialization with enhanced UI

The Event Endpoint Management 11.0.0 UI is available with an enhanced user experience, making Kafka topic discovery, and socialization simpler.

Integration with IBM API Connect

You can integrate Event Endpoint Management 11.0.0 with IBM API Connect 10.0.6, when deployed as part of IBM Cloud Pak for Integration.

Simpler installation

Event Endpoint Management 11.0.0 can be installed with significantly reduced requirements and prerequisites compared to prior releases.

Gateway groups

Event Endpoint Management 11.0.0 has updated Event Gateway deployment options and topologies by using gateway groups.

Known issues

  • Manager logs contain java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException messages.
  • Event Gateway in Evicted state
  • Invalid schema payload in exported AsyncAPI for API Connect
